analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI entered oversold territory, MACD histogram improvement is slowing. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at $250.65 matching the 20-day low. Volume is subdued at 0.62x the 5-day average. Considering ATR of $6.47 (2.56%), the current price of $252.35 is 0.67% above the swing support of $250.65 and 2.27% below the swing resistance of $258.08.
